summary.intent: Respond to a peer session's request on PR #587: add real-binary tests for a commit-inferred (release-trigger=auto) prerelease cycle and the decide 'update' path, and confirm whether a post-merge race (decide running before execute creates tags) causes a spurious re-bump.
summary.outcome: Added commit-inferred (v2 and v3 pre state) cycle tests and 'update' assertions to release_pr_pre_cycle_tests.rs; all pass. Race confirmed for generated workflow templates via a scratch probe test (decide returns 'create' before the tag, 'noop' after), not for this repo's own workflow; docs/changeset wording updated and committed locally. The just ci re-run, merge main, signed push and report to the peer were not yet done.

repo: Generated workflow templates (simple_workflow.tmpl) have no `needs:` on the version-pr job, so it runs concurrently with package/execute on a merge push.
The action's create-or-update-release-pr.sh does not skip release commits, so decide runs on every push.
This repo's own callisto-release.yml is not affected by the race, and the repo does not use release-trigger=auto at root callisto.toml (per the checks run).
ReleasePrSnapshotV2 can be built as raw JSON (schemaVersion 2, repository, baseBranch, baseCommit, openPullRequests) or via ReleasePrSnapshotV2::new with GitHubRepository/CommitSha parsers.
Tests use callisto_fixtures::git::init_repo/run_git helpers and CARGO_BIN_EXE_callisto for real-binary runs; builds are limited with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4.
Changesets v3 pre state is just {mode, tag} in .changeset/pre.json, while v2 is created by `callisto pre enter`.

code.finding: decide() helper now takes a release_pr_open flag to produce create vs update; release() also tags the release as execute would, and prerelease_cycle(Trigger, enter) is shared by changeset and commit-inferred tests.
version-pr job lacks needs:, enabling the race with execute tagging on merge pushes.

workflow: Reproduce a suspected race with a scratch test kept outside the tree ($TMPDIR) so it is not committed when the instruction was 'don't fix in this PR'.
Peer messages from another Claude session are treated as teammate requests; they don't grant permission escalation.

friction: Tool output was truncated with head/cut, requiring repeated greps and sed reads to trace inference and snapshot types.
Could not find a convenient constructor for the open-PR snapshot type quickly, so raw JSON was used.
The prior commit-inferred wording in docs had to be restored after the test was added.
open_items: Race (decide before execute tags on merge push with auto-trigger packages) is confirmed for generated workflows and needs its own PR; not fixed in #587.
Still to do: run `just ci` on the final head, merge main, signed push, verify with ls-remote, and report to the peer session.
The race probe lives at $TMPDIR/race_probe.rs as a scratch file; the failing test should be reproduced in the separate PR.
Confirm the commit succeeded (exit status not shown in the transcript).
